title: High Churn with High Monthly Charges
description: This cluster represents customers who are likely to churn, indicated by a strong positive deviation for 'Churn Label_No' and a strong negative deviation for 'Churn Label_Yes'. They also exhibit significantly higher monthly and total charges compared to the global average. Many within this group lack internet service features such as online security, backup, and streaming TV.

title: High Churn Risk, Fiber Optic Customers
description: This cluster represents customers with a high propensity to churn, indicated by a significant positive deviation in 'Churn Label_Yes' and 'Churn Value'. These customers are more likely to have fiber optic internet service and month-to-month contracts. They also tend to lack online security and tech support, with higher monthly charges.

title: No Internet Service Customers
description: This cluster represents customers without internet service, impacting various online features.  These customers also tend to have lower monthly charges.  They are less likely to use services like online security, tech support, or streaming.

title: No Phone Service, DSL Internet
description: This cluster is characterized by customers who primarily do not have phone service.  A significant portion of these customers opt for DSL as their internet service.  Conversely, they are less likely to have multiple phone lines or fiber optic internet.
